name: Psychic Rain
source:
The game is about a girl named Saya Amamiya who has supernatural powers. She attends a school that's for the gifted ones but outside she's called a monster due to her powers always going crazy when it rains.

This was an April Fool's joke game made by Karin Entertainment. It could only be attained during that single day.
